shortDescription: Spain posted a current account surplus of €2.41 billion ($2.80 billion) in June, compared to a surplus of €5.33 billion in the same month a year earlier, the Bank of Spain said on Monday.That compared to a surplus of €1.84 billion in May, according to the central bank.($1 = 0.8621 euros)

children: Spain posted a current account surplus of €2.41 billion ($2.80 billion) in June, compared to a surplus of €5.33 billion in the same month a year earlier, the Bank of Spain said on Monday.
That compared to a surplus of €1.84 billion in May, according to the central bank.
